target.title: feat: classify apply skip next actions
target.body:
﻿> Dependency: this PR is stacked on #391 (`codex/problem-focused-apply-health`). Please land #391 first, then rebase/review this follow-up. Until then, GitHub may show the #391 commits in the diff.

## What Problem This Solves

After #375, ClawSweeper rotates through apply candidates, but skip-heavy windows can still leave operators with raw skip reason names and no obvious next action. Reasons like `skipped_changed_since_review`, `skipped_pr_close_coverage_proof`, and `skipped_open_closing_pr` are meaningful to the code, but not enough for a maintainer trying to decide what to inspect, rerun, or leave alone.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Adds durable `next_actions` and `next_action_buckets` to apply report summaries.
- Maps common skip reasons to human-readable action labels, owners, retryability, and next steps.
- Teaches the live dashboard to prefer those durable next-action labels and guidance instead of guessing from raw skip names.
- Keeps the visible dashboard low-noise: it only shows aggregate follow-up detail when there are multiple categories to distinguish, and stable non-retryable skips do not get misleading rerun commands.
- Documents the skip follow-up buckets in `docs/live-dashboard.md`.

## User Impact

Maintainers can tell whether a skip-heavy apply run needs a fresh review, close-proof work, maintainer judgement, live-state recovery, report repair, or no action. This turns "ClawSweeper skipped a lot of things" into a concrete operational queue without weakening any close gates.

## Evidence

- `pnpm run build:all` passed.
- `node --test test\repair\workflow-utils.test.ts test\dashboard-worker.test.ts` passed: 72 passed, 0 failed.
- `pnpm run format:check -- dashboard/worker.ts src/repair/workflow-utils.ts test/repair/workflow-utils.test.ts test/dashboard-worker.test.ts` passed.
- `PNPM_BIN=$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Corepack\shims\pnpm.CMD; pnpm run check` passed: 1135 passed, 1 skipped, coverage lane 100%, format clean.
- Direct CLI proof passed with a synthetic apply report containing changed-since-review, proof-blocked, open-closing-PR, and stable skip cases. The summary emitted `next_action_buckets={"close_coverage_proof":1,"defer_until_closing_pr":1,"review_refresh":2,"stable_skip":1}` and first action `Refresh review`.
- Codex review: `codex.cmd -c service_tier='"'"'fast'"'"' review --uncommitted` completed with no actionable findings.

## Screenshot Proof

Problem-focused alert with concrete follow-up labels:

![Apply skip next actions alert](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/clawsweeper/693972e504d47b46695103dccfd7eac3433d84dd/docs/proof/skip-next-actions/apply-skip-next-actions-alert.png)

Healthy/idle pruning health remains quiet:

![Quiet pruning health](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/clawsweeper/693972e504d47b46695103dccfd7eac3433d84dd/docs/proof/skip-next-actions/apply-skip-next-actions-quiet.png)

## Risk Notes

- This does not loosen close/apply gates.
- This does not dispatch repair, review, close, or comment actions by itself.
- The PR only classifies and surfaces deterministic follow-up guidance from existing apply outcomes.
